# Support & Community Guidelines

Thank you for using **WP Quiet Admin**!

## Passion Project Notice & Support Boundary

WP Quiet Admin is an independent, free open-source passion project created and maintained by **David @ RemarkablePC**. 

Because this tool is provided 100% free of charge and maintained during personal time:

* **No 1-on-1 Technical Support**: We cannot provide private troubleshooting, direct email assistance, or guaranteed support via phone, website contact forms, or direct messages.
* **No SLAs or Guaranteed Response Times**: Inquiries and discussion threads are reviewed purely at the creator's discretion and personal availability.

## Where to Connect & Get Help

* **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/remarkablepc/WP-Quiet-Admin/discussions)**: Have a question, want to share an idea, or want to discuss how WP Quiet Admin handles a specific plugin's notices? Join the conversation in GitHub Discussions. Community members are warmly encouraged to assist one another.
* **Documentation & FAQs**: Check our [README.md](README.md) and the in-plugin settings tab for detailed guides on how notices are categorized, safe pass-through controls, and how client-side review suppression works.
